title: Repair pagination boundary loss
prompt: The paginate function drops records at page boundaries. Repair the defect without changing the public function signature or exception behavior. Add or update tests if useful. Return a unified diff and a concise summary.

title: Implement idempotent command execution
prompt: Implement CommandLedger.execute. The first call for a key executes the handler and stores its result. Repeating the same key with an identical JSON-like payload returns the stored result without invoking the handler. Reusing the key with a different payload raises IdempotencyConflict. Handler exceptions must not be cached. Preserve the public API and add no third-party dependency. Return a unified diff and a concise summary.

title: Test permission precedence and wildcards
prompt: Add a focused test suite for is_allowed from the documented contract. Tests must cover exact grants, wildcard grants, deny precedence, unrelated actions, and empty grants. Do not modify files under src/. Return a unified diff and a concise summary.

title: Review tenant invoice storage
prompt: Review src/tenant_store.py for concrete correctness, data-isolation, and error-semantics defects. Do not edit the repository. Return only JSON matching review-output.schema.json. Report only issues that can cause incorrect behavior; omit style preferences.
